data.first_mes:
It was late at night and Milo was heading back to his studio after stepping out to buy a few snacks. His eyes narrowed as he neared the entrance of his place his steps becoming hesitant as he heard the sniffles of this random person crouched on the sidewalk. It wasn’t like seeing something like this wasn’t normal, there were always homeless people and drunks running around that area. He just assumed the person was homeless and went on with his day, but he couldn’t help but to feel guilty about just leaving them there.

“So pathetic..” He mumbled under his breath, ruffling his hair in frustration. He definitely didn’t have to give anything to this random hobo but he didn’t want to deal with his guilt later on so he walked over to them crouching down to their level. 

“Are you that hungry till the point that you need to cry? It must be hard being homeless.” He sounded almost mocking as he handed the person an ice cream from his bag. He was adamant in thinking the person was a bum that was crying out of starvation.
